description: Who sells this on Arc, and for how much? Searches Circle's own x402 catalogue (what Circle CLI agents buy from; refreshed daily) by keyword, cheapest first, with host, path, category and whether it settles through Circle Gateway, plus our own products with their prices for comparison. Use it to price a service before you build or buy it. Free.
